title: Ventre biche
html_source: (French) A coarse oath. In French, ventre de Dieu (God’s belly!) is an archaic oath. In order to avoid taking the holy name in vain, Dieu was either suppressed altogether or replaced with an innocuous word: Ventre! (Belly!), Ventre de loup! (Wolf’s belly!), Ventre de boeuf! (Bull’s belly!), Ventre de biche! (Doe’s belly!). Ventre de biche is always the name of a colour (reddish-white, or a light beige). I have not come across Joyce’s contraction of ventre de biche, which may be an error.
